text: Chottori Tombs Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Chottori Tombs Type: Monument - Tomb Province: Sindh District: Mirpur Khas Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 18th Century CE Description: These Kalhora period (18th Century CE) tombs are those of important Talpur personalities who had held important positions during the Kalhora rule. Among them include Arzi Khokhar, Mir Khan Talpur, Mir Jado, Murad Khan, Mir Musa Khan, Mir Rajo, Mir Fateh Khan, Females of Mir Dynasty, Aulia Pir Badshah Qureshi, a mosque, etc. Latitude: 25.657175000 Longitude: 69.076352778 Ownership: Government of Sindh Legal Status: Protected by The Antiquity Act 1975 (As amended in 1992) Title of Publication: Inventory of Cultural Property in the Province of Sindh, Pakistan, 2015 Published In: Government of Sindh, Vol 3 Year of Publication: 2015 Bibliography/Reference: Jansen, Michael, Yasmeen Lari No photo available for this site yet Social Media Links Contact Info (+92) 51-9252516 info@doam.gov.pk Sir Syed Memorial Building, 19th Atta-Turk Avenue, Sector G-5/1, Islamabad Quick Links - National Heritage & Culture Division, Government of Pakistan - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, KPK - Directorate of Archaeology Tourism Department, Punjab - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, Balochistan - Culture, Tourism, Antiquities and Archive Department, Sindh - Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology & Museums Department Gilgit-Baltistan - National Museum of Pakistan, Karachi - Islamabad Museum, Islamabad - UNESCO, Islamabad office, Islamabad - UNESCO World Heritage Centre Department of Archaeology and Museums © 2026.
